notes.title: New screenshots and preparation for the trailer!
notes.content:
Updated the game page and added fresh screenshots!

Now you can get a better look at the atmosphere, environment, and how the project has evolved. Check it out:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129900/Murmurs_of_Fear__A_whisper_of_loneliness/

I’ll be starting work on the trailer soon. If you have any suggestions — let me know! And if any influencers or media folks out there can help spread the word, I’d really appreciate it.

And most importantly: [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] — it truly helps the game, especially before release! 🎮

notes.title: 🎉 Happy New Year 2025, friends! 🎮
notes.content:
I wish you not just health and happiness in the new year but also some true gaming magic! 

May your Steam carts overflow with long-awaited discounts, and achievements fall as easily as if you're breezing through a tutorial level! 💎

Let 2025 be a year of unforgettable stories, adrenaline-filled battles, and games that keep you hooked until dawn. And most importantly—always find that "dream game" that becomes your personal GOTY. 🕹️

🎆 I also have great news: I’ve updated the Murmurs of Fear page! Check it out here:
👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129900/Murmurs_of_Fear__A_whisper_of_loneliness/]Here[/url]

Thank you for your support and feedback—you’re the best! 🚀

Happy New Year, gamers, and let the epic journey begin! 🔥

notes.title: Murmurs of Fear – coming soon!
notes.content:
You can get Murmurs of Fear for free!

Just purchase Pathogen X by December 31, 2024, and Murmurs of Fear will be yours for free!


Two incredible horror games await you:

*Pathogen X – an intense survival horror with a unique atmosphere.
*Murmurs of Fear – a mystical thriller that keeps you on edge until the very end.

Hurry up! This offer is limited and only available until the end of the year!
